$comment: The proof cell's field map, named by SPA_FIELD_MAP in cell.env beside it. Owner: workstream 1. Each entry is one field of the outputs document (contracts/infra-outputs.schema.json), the root that answers it, named as the last segment of its directory on SPA_ROOTS, and that root's Terraform output. write_outputs (tools/scripts/cell-common.sh) writes these fields, in this order, and nothing else. A field marked optional is written when its root publishes a non-null value and left out when not: the platform root's ecs_bastion_service is null with its bastion input false (#1167).
